scope: Device balanced active-level decomposition and torus monomial substitution/public scale lift, as prerequisites for Double Decomposition and automorphism key switching. No device key switch or encrypted conjugation is implemented or validated by these primitives.

decomposition.headroom: rows*base_bits <= limbs*64 required; 63-bit input in 64-bit storage with base18 rejected
decomposition.reference: CPU MultiLimbUInt centering at log_q, addition of the full native Bbar offset for bases dividing storage width or the active offset for base18, then exact row shifts/masks.

substitution_lift.reference: Direct coefficient-space X^exponent map modulo X^N+1, with CPU MultiLimbUInt level reduction/public lift/negation and output mask.
substitution_lift.scope_note: Polynomial substitution changes the ciphertext secret. A corresponding device key switch is still required.

input_boundaries: maximum signed positive and minimum signed negative active-level values
random native words with garbage bits above log_q
host_ubsan_scope: NVCC -O1 -g and -Xcompiler=-fsanitize=undefined,-fno-sanitize-recover=all,-fno-omit-frame-pointer instruments both source/test host routines and portable inline arithmetic. Device kernels are not UBSan instrumented and were not executed.
historical_scope_note: Hashes/builds above describe the torus-primitives revision. Latest key-switch contraction revision repeats these host checks; device execution remains skipped.
